subject: scaled fit measures with categorical response variable

messages.author: de003433ccddd37b
messages.subject: scaled fit measures with categorical response variable
parts:
I am seeking clarification regarding the output for fit measures in a model with a categorical endogenous variable (using lavaan version 0.5-14). 

I noticed that the fit measures include both the fit indices (for example - cfi) and those indices ".scaled" (cfi.scaled). Are these scaled values calculated based on the scaled chi square value? Are these scaled values then the more appropriate indices to report when using categorical data?

Many thanks - Monica

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: scaled fit measures with categorical response variable
parts:
On 12/04/2013 09:34 PM, Monica Dorning wrote:
> I noticed that the fit measures include both the fit indices (for
> example - cfi) and those indices ".scaled" (cfi.scaled). Are these
> scaled values calculated based on the scaled chi square value?

Yes.

> Are thes scaled values then the more appropriate indices to report when using
> categorical data?

Yes, they are. They are the ones that appear in the rightmost column
(under de heading) 'Robust' in the summary(fit, fit.measures=TRUE) output.

Yves.
